name: Blender Plate Kit
purpose: Canonical bpy helper (mlab.py) and runner (run_plate.py) that every Blender plate uses: seconds and GSAP easing instead of frames, palette roles from the style sheet, short-side camera framing per format, seeded randomness, studio sets, lights, simulations; plus the plate templates in templates/blender/plates/.
capabilities: lab.f / cue / pick / rng / color / material / primitive / cyclorama / camera(subject_y) / key / orbit / on_frame / particles / rigid
run_plate.py: factory-startup scene, render settings from the job, simulation bake, PNG frames, done.json

installation.instructions: Used in place by scripts/visual-director.py; projects copy templates, never the kit.

compatibility.notes: Version-tolerant socket and action helpers; tested on Blender 5.2.4.

licensing.notes: Original workspace code calling the Blender Python API at run time; no Blender code copied.

security.notes: Runs inside Blender only; writes the job's frames folder.

approval_evidence: 2026-11-24 Windows: hero-orbit rendered and composited end to end; all four templates rendered in tests/test-visual-director.py.
